conclusion: The ProtoThrive deployment at https://4a5ddf7d.protothrive-frontend.pages.dev/ demonstrates strong frontend implementation with excellent accessibility, mobile responsiveness, and core authentication flows. However, CRITICAL legal compliance pages are missing (privacy policy and terms of service), making it unsuitable for production user registration. Additionally, 50% of footer links are broken, and primary dashboard functionality (roadmap creation/editing) is incomplete. The deployment is acceptable for demonstration purposes but requires immediate fixes before accepting real users.
